summary: Scope finite-work memory pressure to its lanes and protect host free memory

schema.detail: No client schema, generated code or API shape changes.

rules.detail: Linux finite-work admission reads memory PSI from the aggregate lane cgroup instead of host-wide memory PSI. Lane pressure or MemAvailable below the configured absolute floor trips the existing sustained brake; recovery requires healthy lane pressure and available memory for the existing resume interval. IO PSI remains host-wide. Missing, malformed or stale required observations still close admission.

compatibility.detail: Existing psiBrake policies remain valid. Optional memoryAvailableFloorBytes defaults to 2147483648 bytes (2 GiB), an absolute floor rather than a percentage.

downtime.detail: The new signal takes effect after daemon restart.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no data migration.
